thread:
Sam (AE): Heads-up — Meridian Analytics' GC/E&C just escalated. They are pausing POC stage-2 pending: 1) BYOK onboarding plan + attestation, 2) explicit static egress IPs with an ops cutover window, 3) a short p95 SLA for inference. They want a clear exec decision on trial credit economics by EOD.

Ivy (SE): Repro'd TLS drops from their office subnet. Quick probe:
```
curl -Iv --resolve api.redwood-infer.net:443:54.33.22.11 https://api.redwood-infer.net/health
# observed intermittent RST from their proxy after 10-20s
```

Ivy (SE): Short mitigation: provide 3 static egress IPs + a private-link endpoint. We can also stand up a 14-day Dedicated sandbox in region to guarantee tail latency.

Noel (Security): We can produce a one-page BYOK attestation and the KMS integration runbook within 24h. BYOK via AWS KMS or customer HSM supported; Legal needs to approve a narrow DPA addendum for key audit access. I'll draft and share.

deploy-bot: deployment 1745554355 created meridian-dedicated-sandbox-eu-west-1 (2x-gpu). Egress IPs reserved: 54.33.22.11, 54.33.22.12, 54.33.22.13.

Kat (CS): I'll open the security questionnaire and schedule a CISO call tomorrow AM. I'll prep a one-pager showing BYOK steps and network checklist.

Priya (Head of Sales): Proposed offer: 14-day dedicated sandbox + BYOK onboarding + private-link. Ask for a 12-month reserved conversion if they proceed. Recommend approving up to $50k in trial credits to close the exec ask. Need revenue signoff for credit cap.

Sam (AE): Action items: @Noel share attestation draft, @Ivy confirm 7/14 day cost and credit ask, @Kat schedule CISO call and checklist, @Priya confirm credit cap approval path.

Sam (AE): Question to execs: approve up to $50k in trial credits and expedited legal review for the DPA addendum to unblock Meridian? Need decision within 12h or they will pause the POC. :hourglass:
